definitions.short: a monster (as preternaturally formed), i.e. a sea-serpent (or other huge marine animal); also a jackal (or other hideous land animal)
definitions.full: H8565. tan [ תַּן ] noun [masculine and] feminine Lam 4:3 jackal (so most; Tr NHB 109 ff., 263 f. Shipley-Cook Ency. Bib. JACKAL ; but wolf Post Hast. DB DRAGON , compare Che Isa 13:22 and (rare) Arabic ); — plural תַּנִּים Micah 1:8 +, תַּנִּין Lam 4:3 (Ges § 87e ), לְתַנּוֺת Mal 1:3 (si vera lectio; ᵐ5 Thes and others interpret = dwellings , Sta Now conjecture נְאוֺת , Marti לְ נָתַתִּי ); — jackal , howling mournfully in waste places, Micah 1:8 ; Job 30:29 (both || יַעֲנָה בְּנוֺת ), Isa 13:22 (|| אִיִּים ), in desert also 43:20 (|| יַעֲנָה בְּנוֺת ); deserted sites called ת ׳מְעוֺן Jer 9:10 ; 10:22 ; 49:33 ; 51:37 , ת ׳נְוֵה Isa 34:13 ; 35:7 , ת ׳מְקוֺם Psalms; ׳ת מִדְבָּר Mal 1:3 (si vera lectio, but see above); ׳ת as snuffing up wind Jer 14:6 , giving suck Lam 4:3 .
